Results.ReviewText: This is my first gas grill and I love everything about it. It's simple to use, gets nice and hot very quickly, has a large cooking surface, grills evenly, cleans up in a snap and was easy to assemble. ClientResponses.Response: Hello, the Flavorizer bars can develop surface corrosion due to their exposure to high heat and food drippings.They don’t need to be replaced unless they have holes or cracks in them. Results.ReviewText:
I was given this grill as a gift and was so happy because I have always wanted a weber grill but couldn't justify spending that kind of money. I was highly disappointed when putting it together. I remember for years when I went to go look at them the lids were super heavy and the knobs were metal and rubber, now plastic and the lid is light weight junk. So it broke my heart to have to tell my mother in law that I wanted to return her gift. But there is no world where the cheap junk is worth what she paid for it. I'm sorry weber but way to let your game start slipping. If you are going to save money on materials then pass the savings on to us. Quit selling junk
and charging quality prices.
Results.Title: Quality has gone down hill

Results.ReviewText: I wanted a grill that was totally enclosed on all sides.  This makes it very hard to load a full tank of gas.  I struggled to slide the tank inside and scratched the surface of the floor.  This unit should have a slide in the bottom to assist in loading the tank.  I placed a piece of plywood with soft felt strips so I could slide the tank in position.  I know that it couldn't go into the hole for the tankl.  When the tank becomes half full, I will remove the board and place the tank in the proper position.

Results.ReviewText:
For a backround comparison I am an experienced griller.  I have owned many grills. I currently own. Rec Tec BFG, Weber Q1200, Large @@@@@ This new spirit has terrible temperature control and very poor grease drainage.  My unit either wants to spike to 600 degrees no matter where you have the gas.  I have tried multiple burner configurations and dial settings with no luck in keeping a desired temperature.  This grill with the poor grease drainage has flare ups more often then any other gas grill I have ever used.  I have much better results cooking on my Weber Q series grill. I will be getting rid of this grill as it performs so poorly.   

This grill was a replacement for a much older Weber 2 burner that performed rather well but due to its age looked terrible. I am very disappointed in this new grill.
Results.Title: Poor Heat Control

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
